description: On the bed in front of you are two small white drawer-like blocks on a dark blue sheet, with a pillow propped up at the back. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the smaller block by its knob and slide it toward the larger block, while the left hand comes in to steady the larger block; then both hands align and stack the pieces into a single taller unit, and finally the right hand lets go while the left hand rests nearby.
